q: Razborov's monotone circuit lower bound for the clique function CLIQUE_{k,n} (does a graph have a k-clique?) uses:
opts: The approximation method — showing no small monotone circuit can simultaneously accept random cliques and reject random sets without large cliques
exp: Razborov (1985): the approximation method assigns approximate Boolean functions to circuits. Any monotone circuit for CLIQUE must distinguish two distributions; the method shows this requires exponential monotone circuit size via an entropy/counting argument.
